•  Consult OneView.

•  The message will read “Server Blade Enclosure Power Requested Denied: Not Enough Cooling

warning.

•  The message will read “Server Blade Enclosure Power Requested Denied: Electronic Keying or I/O
Configuration Error (Enclosure Serial Number <serial number>, Slot <blade slot location>)”.

enclosure. Applies to c-Class and Synergy.
•  This is due to a hardware configuration error.
•  Consult OneView (Synergy) or Onboard Administrator (c-Class).

enclosure.
